Class CellBufferTesting

Namespace
Tuinet.Testing

Tuinet.dll

Test assertions and dumps for a Tuinet.CellBuffer: a styled text format for snapshot files, ANSI for eyeballing in a terminal, and finding text on screen. Allocates freely: these are for tests, not frames.

ToAnsi(CellBuffer)

The buffer as ANSI text (SGR colors and attributes, 24-bit where the cell is), one line per row, each ending with a reset. Print it to look at a frame in a real terminal: Console.WriteLine(buffer.ToAnsi()).

public static string ToAnsi(this CellBuffer buffer)

buffer CellBuffer

Returns

string

ToStyledString(CellBuffer)

The buffer as Tuinet.Markup, one line per row: text in the default style is plain, styled text is wrapped in a tag, e.g. [fg=#F5A623 b]ITEMS[/], and a literal [ is [[. When a row is mostly one style with a background (a panel), that style opens the row and tags inside it hold only what differs. Stable, so it suits snapshot files (see Tuinet.Testing.Snapshot), and Tuinet.Testing.Snapshot.Parse(System.String) reads it back exactly. Rows are full width, like Tuinet.CellBuffer.ToString. Hyperlinks and the cursor aren't included.

public static string ToStyledString(this CellBuffer buffer)
